.load ./thinkthen

-- the options ride inside the question, as JSON:
-- billing, shipping, and account
WITH t(body) AS (VALUES
    ('I was billed twice for one order.'),
    ('My parcel is a week late.'),
    ('I am locked out of my account.'))
SELECT thinkthen_choose(
    '{"choose": "Which team owns this?",
      "options": ["billing", "shipping", "account"]}',
    body), body
FROM t;
